notes: Discovery universe is all tradable long U.S. equities with a current price greater than $0. Includes sub-$2 stocks, low-market-cap stocks, and stocks already up more than 30% on the day. Do not impose arbitrary price, market-cap, percentage-gain, sector, exchange, minimum-volume, watchlist, popularity, momentum, gap, catalyst, or FOMO restrictions at discovery. Scanner filters rank and prioritize candidates; they do not define the universe. Tradability, stale-data, spread, liquidity, Level 2, and broker execution rules remain valid post-discovery checks.
